audience: Codex app users and operators updating desktop, browser, and automation workflows
candidate_text:
Codex app update (Jun 11): Developer mode gives Browser controlled CDP access, Browser is faster, `/init` reaches the app composer, and rate-limit reset banking/referrals land for eligible users.

Source: https://developers.openai.com/codex/changelog/#codex-2026-06-11-app
evidence_notes: The official Codex changelog lists a Codex app update on 2026-06-11.
The changelog says the Codex app added rate-limit reset banking for Plus and Pro users, with referral invitation paths during the current promotion and Business coworker referral credits.
The changelog says Developer mode gives Browser use in Chrome and the Codex in-app browser controlled Chrome DevTools Protocol access for profiling and deeper debugging.
The changelog says the app composer now supports the /init command for creating project instructions with the same initialization workflow as the Codex CLI.

The changelog says Browser use is up to 2x faster through CDP and DOM snapshot optimizations, and it lists Developer mode recovery, Browser download handling, scheduled automation approval-mode, Codex Mobile QR pairing, remote-control MFA, and other fixes.

claims.text: The 2026-06-11 Codex app changelog is an official Codex app checkpoint.
The update adds Developer mode for Browser use in Chrome and the Codex in-app browser with controlled CDP access for profiling and debugging.
The update adds rate-limit reset banking and referral-based reset earning paths for eligible users or workspaces.
The update adds /init to the app composer and improves Browser performance through CDP and DOM snapshot optimizations.

decision.reason: The official changelog has concrete app changes that answer what changed, who can use it, and what source proves it.

caveats: This candidate is based only on the official Codex changelog; do not infer CLI, GitHub prerelease, mobile, or Decodex runtime behavior from it.
Developer mode, Computer Use, reset banking, and referral details may be plan, workspace, platform, region, or promotion gated; keep public copy inside the changelog wording.
